key_insight: CLIFE brings camera-LiDAR fusion to the edge by combining online calibration with lightweight late-fusion tracking, making roadside VRU perception more practical for real intersections. The key advance is an edge-deployable design that aims to stay reliable under occlusions, bad weather, and changing lighting.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the challenge of detecting and tracking vulnerable road users from roadside sensors when conditions are difficult and deployment must fit strict edge-computing and latency limits. Existing fusion systems often depend on cloud or server-grade hardware, which is unrealistic for many intersection deployments.
method: Uses a camera-LiDAR fusion framework tailored for roadside VRU perception.
Includes targetless online calibration to align sensors without manual calibration targets.
Applies lightweight late-fusion tracking to keep computation efficient for edge deployment.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, CLIFE shows how to design multi-sensor perception systems that are both accurate and deployable under real-world constraints. This is especially valuable for intelligent transportation, where low latency and robust performance matter as much as model quality.

paper_title: CLIFE: Camera-LiDAR Fusion Framework for Edge-Deployable Roadside VRU Perception
paper_authors: Tam Bang, Hoang H. Nguyen, Lei Cheng, Lihao Guo, Siyang Cao
